# packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(paletteer)
library(patchwork)
library(tmap)
library(terra)
library(sf)

my_theme <- function(title_size = 22, text_size = 20, ...) {
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 22,
        face = "bold",
        colour = "black",
        family = "tachoma"
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(size = text_size),
      strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = text_size, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = title_size, colour = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = title_size, colour = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = text_size, colour = "black"),
      ...
    )
}
```

# Multi-year herbivore abundance/density trends

```{r}
abund <- read.csv("2025/data/abund_est.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(common_name, x2023, x2024, x2025) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("x"),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) |>
  mutate(year = str_remove(year, "x")) |>
  filter(is.na(abundance) == FALSE) |>
  group_by(common_name) |>
  mutate(n = n(), year = ymd(paste(year, "01", "01"))) |>
  filter(n == 3)

abund |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = abundance)) +
  geom_line(aes(), size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(), size = 3) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y", date_breaks = "1 year") +
  my_theme(legend.position = "none", ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Estimated abundance") +
  facet_wrap(~common_name, scales = "free_y")

abund <- read.csv("2025/data/dens.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names()

abund |>
  ggplot(aes(x = survey, y = density)) +
  geom_line(aes(), size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(), size = 3) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = density - density_se, ymax = density + density_se),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  my_theme(legend.position = "none", ) +
  facet_wrap(~common_name, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Estimated density (per km²)")
```

# River flow (Rundu water level, 2010-2024)

```{r}
Rundu_Water_Level_Data_2010_2024 <- read_excel(
  "shared/reference/Rundu Water Level Data 2010-2024.xlsx"
)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

Rundu_Water_Level_Data_2010_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = year(date),
    month = month(date),
    # Define water_year starting from October
    water_year = if_else(month >= 10, year, year - 1),
    # The start of the water year (October 1)
    start_wy = as.Date(paste0(water_year, "-10-01")),
    # Day within the water year (Oct 1 = day 1)
    wy_day = as.numeric(difftime(date, start_wy, units = "days")) + 1,
    water_year_label = paste0(water_year, "/", (water_year + 1) %% 100),
  ) %>%
  # Filter to desired water years
  filter(water_year > 2017) %>%
# Plot daily data
ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    aes(x = wy_day, y = level, colour = factor(water_year_label)),
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  # Create month boundary days for labeling the x-axis
  # Days in each month from October to September (non-leap year assumed):
  # Oct:31, Nov:30, Dec:31, Jan:31, Feb:28, Mar:31, Apr:30, May:31, Jun:30, Jul:31, Aug:31, Sep:30
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(
      1, # Oct 1
      1 + 31, # Nov 1 (Oct has 31 days)
      1 + 31 + 30, # Dec 1
      1 + 31 + 30 + 31, # Jan 1
      1 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31, # Feb 1
      1 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 28, # Mar 1
      1 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 28 + 31, # Apr 1
      1 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 28 + 31 + 30, # May 1
      1 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 31, # Jun 1
      1 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30, # Jul 1
      1 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31, # Aug 1
      1 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 # Sep 1
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Oct",
      "Nov",
      "Dec",
      "Jan",
      "Feb",
      "Mar",
      "Apr",
      "May",
      "Jun",
      "Jul",
      "Aug",
      "Sep"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 10), n.breaks = 10) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Water Level", colour = "Water year") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_colour_paletteer_d("nationalparkcolors::DeathValley", direction = 1) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18),
  )

```

# Inundation extent

```{r}

flood_area <- read_csv("2025/data/inundation/FloodArea_1990-2025.csv")
flood_area |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = sum)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = mean(flood_area$sum),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = seq(from = dmy("01-01-1990"), to = dmy("01-01-2025"), by = "year"),
    date_labels = "%Y"
  ) +
  my_theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(y = "Inundated area (km²)", x = "Year")

rainfall <- read_csv(
  "2025/data/inundation/annual_avg_rainfall_1981_2025_delta.csv"
)
rainfall |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = annual_avg_precipitation)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = mean(rainfall$annual_avg_precipitation),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(from = 1981, to = 2025, by = 1)) +
  my_theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(y = "Mean annual rainfall (mm)", x = "Year")


raster_files <- list.files(
  "2025/data/inundation/maps",
  full.names = TRUE,
  pattern = ".tif$"
)
flood_rasters <- lapply(raster_files, rast)
names(flood_rasters) <- str_extract(basename(raster_files), "\\d{4}")

ng18_boundary <- vect("shared/gis/ng18_boundary.gpkg")

is.valid(ng18_boundary)
test <- flood_rasters[["2011"]] |>
  subst(0, NA)
test_2025 <- flood_rasters[["2025"]] |>
  subst(0, NA)

maps = c(test, test_2025)
names(maps) <- c("2011", "2025")
maps

delta_map <- tm_shape(maps) +
  tm_raster(col.legend = tm_legend_hide()) +

  tm_shape(ng18_boundary, ) +
  tm_lines(lwd = 2) +
  tm_facets_wrap(ncol = 2) +
  tm_graticules(
    labels.size = 1,
    alpha = 0.5,
    labels.rot = c(90, 0),
  ) +

  tm_layout(
    panel.label.bg.color = "white"
  ) +
  tm_compass(
    group_id = "A",
    position = tm_pos_in(0.75, 0.27, align.h = "center")
  ) +
  tm_scalebar(
    text.size = 1,
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50),
    group_id = "A",
    position = tm_pos_in(0.65, 0.15, align.h = "center")
  )
# tm_components(
#   "A",
#   position = tm_pos_in("RIGHT", "BOTTOM", align.h = "center"),
#   stack = "vertical",
#   frame = TRUE,
#   bg = TRUE,
#   bg.color = "white",
#   bg.alpha = 0.5
# )
tmap_save(
  delta_map,
  filename = "shared/figures/flood_extent_delta.png"
)
# tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE, legend.outside.position = "right")
ng18_map <- tm_shape(maps) +
  tm_raster(col.legend = tm_legend_hide()) +
  tm_shape(ng18_boundary, is.main = TRUE) +
  tm_lines(lwd = 2) +
  # tm_facets_wrap(ncol = 2) +

  tm_compass(group_id = "A") +
  tm_scalebar(
    text.size = 1,
    breaks = c(0, 5, 10),
    group_id = "A",
  ) +
  tm_components(
    "A",
    position = tm_pos_in(pos.h = 0.5, pos.v = 0.95, align.h = "center"),
    stack = "vertical",
    frame = TRUE,
    bg = TRUE,
    bg.color = "white",
    bg.alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  tm_graticules(
    labels.size = 1,
    alpha = 0.5,
    labels.rot = c(90, 0),
    labels.inside.frame = TRUE
  ) +
  tm_layout(
    panel.label.bg.color = "white",
    outer.margins = c(0.05, 0.02, 0.02, 0.03),
    inner.margins = c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1),
    frame = TRUE
  )

ng18_map
tmap_save(ng18_map, filename = "shared/figures/flood_extent_ng18.png")

#  tm_shape(maps) +

camps <- vect("shared/gis/qgis_files/Maps (pre course)/Camps.shp")
sites_df <- data.frame(
  Site = c("A", "B", "C"),
  Lat = c(-19.16979806, -19.176043, -19.180786),
  Lon = c(23.702031, 23.693861, 23.686658)
)
sites <- vect(sites_df, geom = c("Lon", "Lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
transects <- vect("shared/gis/qgis_files/transects.gpkg")
plot(transects)
fires <- vect("shared/gis/qgis_files/fires/September'23 Wild fire.shp")
plot(fires)

feature_extent |> plot()

lower_ng18_map <- tm_shape(camps) +

  tm_shape(fires) +
```
